title: Phase-E research model: seven per-surface scores the source forbids as pass rates
status_plain: The annuity spec publishes per-surface scores for seven financial surfaces on a 5,319-row live-Excel corpus, evaluated with a research model. The source disclaims them in two sentences immediately below the table and again in KNOWN_EXACTNESS_DEVIATIONS: they characterise the research model, not the Rust kernel, and must not be reported as OxFunc pass rates. They are recorded here so that the disclaimer travels with them, and because they are the natural contrast to the production replay: on the same 90-row grids, production FV is 89 of 90 where the model is 79 of 90, and production PV is 83 of 90 where the model is 25 of 90. The corpus here is 5,319 rows; the production replay's corpus is 5,154 rows. They are different objects and the two totals may never be reconciled or summed.

open_question: The spec states "The current Rust implementation has not yet been replayed over all 5,319 Phase-E rows through a repo-owned runner." A 5,154-row subset was later replayed (EV-FIN-0001); the remaining 165 rows are not accounted for in any OxFunc document.
reader_warning: The source forbids these as OxFunc pass rates in terms: "These figures characterize the research model, not the current Rust kernel." and "They must not be reported as OxFunc pass rates." CUMIPMT and CUMPRINC appear in this table with no figure at all, only the qualitative cell "recurrence shape supported, exact op-order and accumulated rounding still open" -- so no CUMIPMT or CUMPRINC number may be taken from here.
